title: Locker and Scholarship
author: Xanthe Underhill
blurb: Wendell Blackwood, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
